about: One registry of report types. The skill, the astro-report flow and the /report command read this file; the list shown to the user comes from here. status: built (renders and is tested), planned (listed, not built yet). Owner-approved list 2026-11-14 (T10 Job C, R1). The nine renderer types that existed before T10 are built (they render and have tests); report ids equal the renderer report_type keys.

fields.id: key used by /report and report_type in the model
fields.name: display name
fields.inputs: what must be asked before computing
fields.engine_tools: MCP / service tools that supply the computed fields
fields.spec: section spec (sections in order, fields, conventions, caveats, what to drop)
fields.one_line: the line shown in the menu
